full_prompt_en: A square expressive oil painting fills the frame with the close face of a young woman, her head slightly turned and her eyes looking toward the right. Blue gray eyes, a straight nose, and softly coral lips are carefully modeled within a field of rough, layered paint. Dark hair breaks into black and brown angular marks around the top and left edge, while pale ivory, blush peach, ocher, and cool gray strokes construct the face. Her left cheek catches broad warm light; the right side falls into deeper olive and blue green shadow. Along the far right, a strong vertical red orange block interrupts the face and gives the composition a graphic edge. Near it, smaller blue and ocher fragments suggest worn walls or overlapping painted surfaces without defining a literal place. The bottom of the face and neck dissolve into scraped cream and dark brown pigment, and the upper edge is cut by irregular near black brushwork. Thick paint leaves ridges, scratches, and broken patches, especially outside the smoothest facial planes. Faint horizontal scuffs and tiny flecks cross the cheeks, keeping the image tactile. The crop removes most of the figure and any surroundings; the face occupies nearly all the available space. Diffuse light from the upper left illuminates the forehead, eyes, nose, and lips, while the shadowed edge blends back into textured color. The whole painting is intimate and searching, balancing recognizable expression with energetic abstraction at the boundaries.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形表现性油画以年轻女子的近景面容充满画面，她的头微微转向一侧，目光望向右方。蓝灰眼睛、笔直鼻子和柔和珊瑚色嘴唇在粗粝层叠颜料中得到仔细塑造。深发在上缘和左边缘裂成黑棕色棱角笔痕，浅象牙白、腮红桃色、赭黄与冷灰笔触搭出脸庞。左侧面颊接住宽阔暖光；右侧陷入更深的橄榄与蓝绿阴影。最右边，一条强烈的竖向红橙色块打断脸部，为构图提供图形化边界。其旁较小的蓝与赭色碎片暗示磨旧墙面或重叠涂层，却不限定具体地点。下巴与颈部溶入刮擦的奶油白和深棕颜料，上边缘被不规则近黑笔触切开。厚颜料留下凸脊、刮痕与破碎色块，脸部最平滑的平面之外尤为明显。淡淡水平擦痕与微小斑点穿过双颊，让图像保持可触感。紧密裁切去掉大部分身体及所有环境，脸几乎占满空间。从左上来的漫射光照亮额头、眼睛、鼻子和嘴唇，阴影边缘则混回有纹理的颜色。整幅画亲密而带探寻感，在可辨认神情与边界处充满活力的抽象之间取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: Expressive oil painting combines carefully modeled smooth planes with heavily worked impasto and scraped color. Cream, blush peach, olive, slate blue, black brown, and a strong orange red accent layer into a broken but coherent palette. Thick angular marks frame a softer luminous center; near its edges, the image fragments into patches, scuffs, and partially exposed underlayers. Light enters from the upper left, warming raised pale surfaces and letting the opposite edge sink into cool green brown shadow. Fine scratches and horizontal abrasions cross broader strokes, giving the surface an aged, tactile quality. Forms remain recognizable at the center while peripheral detail deliberately dissolves into painterly abstraction. A single hard vertical accent counterbalances the irregular marks elsewhere. The composition feels intimate, energetic, and contemplative, with precision and roughness occupying the same plane.
style_prompt_zh: 表现性油画把仔细塑造的平滑平面与反复堆叠的厚涂、刮擦色层结合。奶油白、腮红桃色、橄榄绿、石板蓝、黑棕及强烈橙红重音叠成破碎却统一的色域。厚而棱角分明的笔痕框住较软的发亮中心；靠近边缘，图像裂解成色块、擦痕和部分露出的底层。光从左上进入，温暖凸起浅色表面，使相反边缘沉入冷绿棕阴影。细刮痕与水平磨痕穿过宽笔触，赋予表面陈旧、可触的性质。中央形体保持可辨，周边细节则有意融入绘画性抽象。一条坚硬竖向重音平衡别处不规则笔痕。构图亲密、活跃而沉思，让精确与粗粝共处一面。
theme_en: Close painted face emerging from layered urban color
theme_zh: 从层叠城市色块中浮现的近景绘画面孔
name: Nicolai Fechin
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
